matthiaskoenig/livermetabolism-site.summary: A patch release that makes the colours of the network graph readable and lets a person carry research areas of their own.
A patch release adding the sbml2cellml converter to the software list, and a command that assembles the group's newsletter from what the repository already records.
A patch release tidying the navigation bar and the research-area filter introduced in 0.12.0.

one research-area filter for the whole site, in a bar that stays under the navigation as you scroll. Choose Digital Twins, AI, Digital Pathology, Pharmacometrics or Open & FAIR once and every page you visit shows that area until you clear it - publications, projects, news, software, funding…
A patch release fixing the alignment of the landing-page icons and closing three follow-ups from the internationalization work.

the site is now available in US English (the default, at the root) and German (under /de/), with a language switch in the navbar that keeps the current page and any open detail modal · every page renders from one source file under site/pages/[...locale]/, so the two language trees cannot drift…
A patch release of the König Lab website, https://livermetabolism.com, improving consent handling, snapshot link validation, keyboard navigation, mobile layout, and HTTPS redirects.

A patch release of the König Lab website, https://livermetabolism.com: pkpdutils, the refactored successor of pkdb_analysis, joins the software packages and the GitHub statistics, and TypeScript moves to version 6.

/robots.txt welcomes every crawler, AI crawlers and agents included, and points them to the sitemap and the two LLM files; only /detail/, the fragments the detail dialogs load, is kept out, as it already is from the sitemap · /llms.txt follows the llms.txt proposal: a title and short summary of…

the per-page modals (PersonModal, ProjectModal, NewsModal) and their inline bodies are gone; a detail is addressed as #/ (for example /publications/#publication/Koenig2012_x). The old #person-modal-, #project-modal-, and #news-modal- links still open the same detail; the list anchors (#pub-…
A patch release that makes the network page (/network/, new in 0.8.0) easier to read and to handle.

a new "Network" page (/network/, in the navbar and linked from every research-area section of the homepage) draws the lab as a force-directed graph: people with their photos, projects and software with their thumbnails, and publications as dots coloured by research area and sized by citation…
Patch release of the König Lab website, https://livermetabolism.com: the citations-over-time chart on the publications page now starts in 2011 instead of on the day the daily snapshots began.

every publication with a DOI shows how often it has been cited, from OpenAlex, as a badge linking to the OpenAlex record, and an "open access" badge when the paper is openly available; the counts are refreshed daily and updated in the browser like the GitHub and Scholar data · a Year / Most cited…

every software card on the research page carries a stats line with the latest release (linked to the release page), the number of stars, open issues, the time since the last push, the primary language, and the licence; cards whose repository is not on GitHub show no line · a "Latest releases"…

the site is built with Astro (static output) and Vue single-file components styled with Tailwind v4; Jekyll, Liquid templates, Bootstrap, Bootswatch, Sass, the hosted Font Awesome kit, and the hand-written page scripts are gone. Anyone editing templates now works in site/ (pages/, layouts/…
